name: QuizFlow – AI-Powered Quiz Maker
author: FixBD

sections.description:
QuizFlow is an advanced AI-powered quiz builder and management system for WordPress. Built for educators, businesses, content creators, and training professionals who demand unlimited flexibility and enterprise-grade features.

QuizFlow is completely free and always will be. That said, if you’d like to support the project and help us continue improving it, you can upgrade to QuizFlow Pro. The Pro version offers even more advanced features and enhanced functionality for those who need a more powerful solution.
✨ Upgrade to QuizFlow Pro to unlock premium features and priority support.

Key Features:

  • Visual Question Builder – Create quizzes with an intuitive page and question builder directly from the WordPress admin.
  • Multiple Question Types – Support for various question formats to suit any assessment need.
  • Template System – Choose from built-in templates (Default, Modern) or create your own custom templates.
  • Shortcode Support – Embed quizzes anywhere with [quizflow], display archives with [quizflow_archive], or show single quiz posts with [quizflow_single].
  • Block Theme Compatible – Full support for WordPress block themes with custom archive and single post templates.
  • Submission Tracking – Track and manage quiz submissions with a dedicated answer, individual responses, timestamps, and completion data.
  • Timer Support – Add countdown timers to quizzes for timed assessments.
  • AI Integration – Built-in AI capabilities for enhanced quiz analysis.
  • KPI Dashboard – View key performance indicators and quiz statistics at a glance.
  • Detailed Results – Process and display comprehensive quiz results for participants.
  • Analysis – Deep analytics with performance metrics, insights, and reporting
  • Leaderboard – Show quiz leaderboards to encourage competition.
  • Session Management – Secure session handling for quiz-taking experiences.
  • Auto Fraud Detection – Automatically flags suspicious submissions and cheating patterns
  • Translation Ready – Fully translatable with included .pot file and Arabic translation.
  • Full Customization – Branding options, difficulty settings, and flexible configurations.
  • Admin Dashboard – Centralized management area with settings, quiz management, and about pages.
  • License Key System – Built-in license key management for premium features and updates.

Shortcodes:

  • [quizflow id="POST_ID"] – Display a specific quiz.
  • [quizflow_archive] – Display a quiz archive with filtering and statistics.
  • [quizflow_single] – Display the current quiz post content.

Upgrade to Pro:

Want even more power? QuizFlow Pro takes your quizzes to the next level with premium features, advanced analytics, priority support, and automatic updates. Learn more →

Core Capabilities

🤖 AI & Automation

  • ChatGPT Question Builder 🤖 – AI generates questions from any topic or content
  • AI Powered Question Generation ✨ – Auto-create multiple or single questions with options, hints, and correct answers
  • Auto Fraud Detection 🛡️ – Automatically flags suspicious submissions and cheating patterns
  • Smart Scheduling ⏰ – Schedule quizzes to open/close automatically

🛠️ Quiz Builder

  • Powerful Drag and Drop Quiz Builder 🖱️ – Intuitive visual builder for easy quiz creation
  • Hints 💡 – Add helpful hints to guide users through questions

⚡ Unlimited Scale

  • Unlimited Quizzes & Questions ♾️ – No caps, ever
  • Advanced Question Bank 🗄️ – Organize by categories, tags, and difficulty
  • Import/Export 📤📥 – Bulk import questions, export results to CSV

🎨 Question Types & Media

  • Multiple Question Formats 📝 – MCQs, True/False, single questions, flash cards
  • Rich Media Support 🖼️🎥 – Question images, video questions, image answers
  • Question Weighting ⚖️ – Assign custom points to questions and answers
  • Randomization 🎲 – Shuffle questions and/or answers for each attempt

🎨 User Experience & Design

  • Quiz Styles 🎨 – Full control over width, height, colors, backgrounds
  • RTL Language Support 🌍 – Perfect for Arabic, Hebrew, and right-to-left languages
  • Multi-Page Quizzes 📄📄 – Break long assessments into manageable sections
  • Popup & Widget Quizzes 🎯 – Embed anywhere with shortcodes
  • Styles Preview 👁️ – See changes in real-time before publishing

🔒 Security & Access Control

  • Password Protection 🔐 – Lock quizzes with custom passwords
  • User Login Required 👤 – Restrict to registered users only
  • Copy Protection 🚫📋 – Prevent content theft and copying
  • Track Users 👣 – Monitor individual user activity and progress

🏆 Results & Engagement

  • Leaderboards 🏅 – Live rankings to drive competition
  • Results with Charts 📊 – Visual analytics for performance tracking
  • Conditional Results 🎭 – Show different outcomes based on scores
  • Certificates 🎓📜 – Auto-generate completion certificates
  • Custom Result Text ✍️ – Personalized feedback based on percentage scores
  • Results Sheet 📋 – Detailed breakdown of every submission

📧 Communication & Data

  • Email Automation 📬 – Send results to users and notifications to admins
  • User Data Collection 📝 – Custom fields to gather additional information
  • User Location Tracking 📍 – Geographic insights on quiz takers
  • Frontend Statistics 📈 – Public or private stats dashboards
  • User Dashboard 🖥️ – Personal hub for participants to view history

🔗 Integrations

  • Educare Integration Ready 🔌 – Seamless compatibility with Educare – Students & Result Management System

🚀 Advanced Features

  • Chained Quizzes ⛓️ – Link multiple quizzes together sequentially
  • Flash Card Mode 🗂️ – Study mode for learning and memorization
  • Required Questions ❗ – Force completion of critical items
  • Frontend Quiz Request 🙋 – Users can request new quizzes
  • Custom Attributes 🏷️ – Add metadata and custom fields
  • Full Email Configuration ⚙️📧 – SMTP and notification customization

External services

This plugin connects to API services provided by FixBD (https://fixbd.com):

  1. FixBD AI API – Quiz Question Generation
    When you use the AI quiz generation feature, the plugin sends the following data:

    • Your selected quiz topic
    • Requested number of questions
    • Your website domain name (to verify user)
    • Server IP address (to verify user)

    This data is transmitted via POST request to FixBD AI only when you explicitly click the “Generate with AI” button in the quiz editor.

    The AI service returns generated quiz questions, answers, and explanations to be imported into your quiz.

  2. FixBD License API – License Key Validation
    When you enter a license key in the plugin settings, the plugin sends the following data:

    • License key entered
    • Your website domain name
    • Server IP address

    This data is transmitted via POST request to FixBD license API to verify the license validity and activation status.

    The service returns license status (active/inactive), expiration date, and feature access permissions.

    This verification occurs: (a) when you first enter/save a license key, (b) periodically to check license status (weekly), and (c) when validating feature access.

These services are provided by “FixBD”: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Use of these services is optional:
– Use of this AI feature is optional. The plugin functions fully without it for manually created quizzes.
– The license validation is only required for premium features – core plugin functions work without a license key
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quizflow folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the QuizFlow menu in the WordPress admin to configure settings.
  4. Create your first quiz by going to QuizFlow > Add New.
  5. Use the question builder to add pages and questions to your quiz.
  6. Embed the quiz on any page or post using the [quizflow id="POST_ID"] shortcode.
sections.faq:
How do I create a quiz?

After activating the plugin, go to QuizFlow > Add New in the WordPress admin. Use the visual question builder to add pages and questions, configure quiz settings, and publish your quiz.

How do I display a quiz on my site?

You can display a quiz using the shortcode [quizflow id="POST_ID"] where POST_ID is the ID of your quiz. You can also use the archive shortcode [quizflow_archive] to display all quizzes.

Can I generate quizzes via AI in the free version?

Yes, you can generate quizzes using AI directly from the quiz builder interface. Enter your topic and settings, and QuizFlow will automatically create questions for your quiz.

Does QuizFlow work with block themes?

Yes, QuizFlow includes full block theme support with custom archive and single post templates that integrate seamlessly with the WordPress Site Editor.

Can I customize the quiz appearance?

Yes, QuizFlow includes a template system with multiple built-in templates. You can also create custom templates by adding them to the templates directory.

Does QuizFlow support timed quizzes?

Yes, you can add countdown timers to your quizzes for timed assessments.

Is QuizFlow translation ready?

Yes, QuizFlow is fully translatable. It includes a .pot file for translations and comes with an Arabic translation out of the box.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit https://fixbd.com/plugins/quizflow to purchase a license key. After purchasing, enter your license key in QuizFlow > License Key to activate Pro features and receive automatic updates.
